Posting window: the last-48h hits landed Sat 11:00-16:30 and Sun 14:51 Amsterdam; nothing posted before 08:00 crossed 5K

virals_narrative: Since this morning's scan the 4.6-minute lexx_aura Halloween film climbed from 1.63M to 1.72M and the Malfoy Seedance clip from 41K to 57.6K. No new watchlist post from the last 24 hours has crossed 5K yet (the freshest, mr_farman_ai's crocodile escape story from 08:35, sits at 218). Outside the watchlist, the 'masterpiece' hook is being cloned by several small accounts into 5-14K, dragons keep winning, and a Grok Imagine Video 1.5 clip reached 4.4K. drafts.text:
Hide the last dragon, or hand it to the king? What would you do? 🐉👇

🐉 THE DRAGON'S LAST KEEPER 🐉

The last egg cracked beneath her hand,
a spark of fire, small and grand.
The king's men hunt with steel and flame,
but she has already given it a name.

🕯️ THE LANTERN BRIDE 🕯️

She waits each year where lanterns glow,
a bride in lace as pale as snow.
Lift her veil and whisper I do,
and her cold vow belongs to you.

drafts.title: 🪞 THE MIRROR THAT CRAWLED BACK
drafts.text:
She buried her reflection under the old oak. Tonight it dug its way out. 🪞🌑

🪞 THE MIRROR THAT CRAWLED BACK 🪞

She hid her face beneath the tree
and swore her shadow would stay free.
But moonlight cracked the glass tonight,
and her own face crawled into the light.
